svg.text: Continuous Multi-Source Surveillance • Bayesian Defect Scoring • pgvector Grounded Intelligence • Incident Early Warning

g.text: • <tspan font-weight="bold" fill="#38BDF8">/overview</tspan>: Summary counts, KPIs, Sentiment
• <tspan font-weight="bold" fill="#38BDF8">/reviews/submit</tspan>: Real-time DB Ingest & Score
• <tspan font-weight="bold" fill="#38BDF8">/alerts</tspan>: Natural Language Rules & Spikes
• <tspan font-weight="bold" fill="#38BDF8">/chat</tspan>: SQL Grounded & NIM AI Assistant
• <tspan font-weight="bold" fill="#38BDF8">/data-quality</tspan>: Live Probes (DB, Vector, Redis)
• <tspan font-weight="bold" fill="#38BDF8">/trends</tspan>: Defect cluster trajectory over time
• <tspan font-weight="bold" fill="#38BDF8">/system/status</tspan>: DB Dialect & Catalog Status
Multi-layer Lexicon: Fire, Burn, Shock, Injury
Upstash Redis connected • Celery tasks offline
REQUIREMENTS COMPLIANCE MATRIX (VERIFIED AGAINST ACTIVE SOURCE CODE)
Ingest feedback from CSV or adapters, normalized and deduped
Detect defect signals with context checks
detector.py, context.py (strips 'burnt toast', 'audio bleeding', 4★ praise), test_safety_detector.py, test_false_alarms.py
Compute a 0–100 hazard score per product from its own reviews
Estimate lead time versus official recall
products.py:154, risk_queue.py:85; returns None ('N/A') when no recall; test_critical_scenario.py (7.4 wks)
Show cited evidence for every score
products.py:137 (verbatim review text, stars, date, danger phrases), test_grounding.py
Ranked risk queue with filter, sort and pagination
Plain-English alert rules with real email & webhook dispatch
Backtest and threshold tuning with CSV export
Ask assistant with RAG mode and AI Chat mode
chat.py (SQL grounded RAG + NVIDIA NIM Llama 3.2), rag.py, explanation.py, test_ask_endpoint_hallucination_refusal
data_quality.py: live DB probe (SELECT 1), real embedding % (0.0%), live Redis/Celery broker probe, data-quality page
Live review submission that updates the dashboard
reviews.py (POST /submit), apps/web2 presets, live polling feed, persistent real-time telemetry sync
Low latency: dashboard < 500 ms, chat < 5 s
Remote Supabase in Seoul adds 2-5s cross-continent RTT on cold queries. Fix: Add Redis caching layer (TTL 30s).
Consistency across pages without manual reload
verify_all.py verifies cross-endpoint match (186 products, 4060 reviews) across system/status and overview/summary
test_false_alarms.py: 0 false alarms on control non-safety complaints; context.py acoustic term filtering
Explainability: every flag points to exact phrase
SafetySignal.phrase stores exact matched string ('caught fire', 'burned my hand'); test_safety_detector.py
Grounding: RAG answers cite retrieved records
explanation.py: citations array maps to [EXT-XXXX] database records; test_grounding.py verifies refusal on missing records
Temporal integrity: backtests never use future data
test_temporal_leakage.py: strictly limits review_date <= as_of_date; verified zero lookahead bias
Reliability: fails loudly, no silent fallback to empty DB
session.py: pool_pre_ping=True, connect_timeout=15; exceptions raise transparently rather than returning dummy data
Scalability: pagination, async workers, indexed vector search
pgvector HNSW index and pagination active. Celery app & Redis broker connected but worker offline. Fix: Daemonize worker.
Security: no secrets in repo, CORS restricted, input validation
Pydantic models validate all inputs, .env gitignored. Permissive allow_origins=['*'] in main.py:25. Fix: restrict origins in prod.
Maintainability and testability: adapters, verify scripts
Unified BaseAdapter protocol pattern, 22 automated tests in run_all_tests.py with 100% pass rate
Usability: loading and empty/error states, responsive
Tailwind CSS responsive design, skeleton cards, and explicit empty filter alerts ('Not enough data yet')
/health, /api/v1/system/status, /data-quality live probes, audit_log table tracking rule, alert, and export telemetry
Reproducibility: seed scripts rebuild identical DB
scripts/seed_db.py and scripts/ingest_amazon_csv.py deterministic generation; clean idempotent re-runs
Single-tenant schema; multi-organization partitioning is planned for enterprise roadmap. Fix: add org_id & tenant claim.
COMPLIANCE SCORE: 🟢 Met: 21 / 25 (84%) | 🟡 Partial: 3 / 25 (12%) | 🔴 Not Met: 1 / 25 (4%) • TOP GAPS: Multi-tenancy (N14), Celery daemon (N8), Latency (N1)
